Generic noncommuting two-by-two inverse identities must simplify exactly to zero.
Generic two-dimensional normalized Gaussian covariance-pair derivative must equal the mixed spatial derivative with its exact edge factor.

Critical determinant derivative and its ordered inverse formula must agree exactly.
Side/corner top-form powers of sigma must cancel for symbolic dimensions and number of sides.
SH side and marked-translation budgets must reduce exactly to SH3 after tau=c sigma p; their sigma exponents must be zero.
The largest side polynomial degree must be 91D+2; four beta/8 expenditures must leave beta/2.

Scaled coarse Cauchy powers must cancel only after v=(sigma p) v_hat.
Adversarial sign/factor/power mutations must be rejected by the corresponding exact identity checks.
